findings.title: R3 evidence closure is not idempotent and cannot reproduce the frozen report/manifest hashes
findings.reproduction: Ran scripts/remaster/r3/close_r3_evidence.py twice with the isolated venv. Run 1 exit 0: report 357b6ab1da116bd45012b43a1becacb0744aafa053bde14ba8dbb8feab64fee4, manifest b7746d4e321863a371faf0ea49d9a0edb75eb1c83b5e32057f4b2598517cf4c2, confinement 11cb3d310db629bc6aebe0caa496a9c4ec715d6beab9b7117038e2fb169a116a. Run 2 exit 0: report b3032edef56a0445c1cdb73e049c594f158f7bbe6aadf6e96434c973b5524e7a, manifest 1ff6dccedfe1206eba4da4589764ff0893f39988db5a5beaff3c307e96432c1a, confinement unchanged.
findings.impact: Report and manifest are byte-different between run 1 and run 2 and both differ from the frozen stated hashes (AB95274E..., 7183BAB2...). The R3-F043 idempotent-closure claim is false: build_evidence.py embeds datetime.now() timestamps into both files, so every run rewrites them. Only the confinement evidence is stable.
findings.disposition: REPAIR_REQUIRED_BEFORE_PROMOTION; R4/next round must make generated_utc deterministic for frozen artifacts or record content digests independent of wall-clock timestamps, then re-freeze report/manifest.
